# Local dependencies

- pdf-lib 1.17.1 — MIT, Andrew Dillon. License in pdf-lib-LICENSE.md. https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 — MIT, Andrew Dillon / Devon Govett. Vendored unmodified standalone UMD distribution from https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdf-lib/fontkit; package README declares MIT. https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
- Fontkit contains pako (MIT/Zlib), © Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn. Embedded in standalone bundle; see pako-LICENSE.
- Liberation Sans — SIL Open Font License 1.1, copyright attribution and full license in ../fonts/LICENSE.txt.

No CDN or package server is used at application runtime.
